name: Datadog

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (enwiki file) - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Datadog logo.svg

description: Datadog sells a cloud monitoring and security platform that software engineering and operations teams use to watch their applications and infrastructure. It covers infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring, log management and security, and adds AI features such as Bits AI SRE. Customers pay subscriptions that are mostly monthly or annual and scale with usage, so revenue grows when customers run more workloads and add more products. It reports a single segment. It has about 32,700 customers, but the 4,310 customers with $100,000 or more annual run-rate revenue account for 90 percent of it.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

employees.note: About 8,100 in 35 countries; about 44% outside the US, 34% of those in France (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Observability and security platform (single segment)
businessLines.how: Customers subscribe per product, mostly billed monthly or annually and scaled by usage; expansion inside existing customers (more products, more usage) drives growth.
businessLines.description: Infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management, security and related products on one platform.

operatingProfit.note: operating loss; FY2024 income $54.3M; FY2023 loss $33.5M
